_comment: Clayworks LITE — full example (script install). Three hooks wired: UserPromptSubmit (Nudge), SessionStart (primer + git warn), Stop (turn log). Copy the companion files in examples/full/hooks/ to ~/.claude/hooks/ first. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json; append, do not replace existing hooks arrays. On a plugin install, drop the UserPromptSubmit block: the plugin already registers it.

hooks._comment: Nudge: adds due alerts to Claude's context next to your prompt
Primer surface + uncommitted-git warning, branching on how the session started. See examples/full/hooks/sessionstart.sh.

Per-turn end-time logging (runs after every response). Extend with a 24h-gated background trigger for dream-style consolidation if you want; see hooks/examples/stop.sh in the LITE repo for the gating skeleton.

_comment_extension: Permissions and env blocks omitted from this example; add at the top level alongside `hooks`. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings for the schema.
